The recurrence and ODE are right: $t_{m+1}=2t_m+2\sum_{k=1}^{m-1}\binom{m}{k}t_kt_{m-k}$ gives $T'=2T^2-2T+1$ with $T(0)=1$. Setting $u=2T-1$ gives $u'=u^2+1$, $u(0)=1$, so $u=\tan(z+\pi/4)$ and $T=\frac{1+\tan(z+\pi/4)}{2}=\frac{1}{1-\tan z}$. The identity $\sec 2z+\tan 2z=\frac{1+\tan z}{1-\tan z}$ shows the two forms agree, and the submitted expression $((\sec(2z)+1)+\tan(2z))/2$ equals $1/(1-\tan z)$. The expansion gives $t_1,\dots,t_4=1,2,8,40$, which matches the recurrence directly.
